description: Implement the `--check` mode logic to compare generated TOC against existing content without writing.
spec:
1. Read the target file's current state.
2. Generate a hypothetical new TOC (using all previous logic).
3. Compare the generated TOC against the existing content block between markers.
4. If they differ, exit with status 1 and display a diff-style message showing what needs updating.
title: Implementing non-destructive check mode for CI/CD use
